confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge and Phnom Penh calibration; no live listings were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately certain; accommodation carries seasonal uncertainty for July. Cocktail (about 2.8x beer) and wine glass (about 3x beer) are derived from the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weak. FX value taken from search-result summaries attributing the 15 Oct 2026 4pm reading to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page; that page was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Phnom Penh (same country, closest price level) anchors most values; Kuala Lumpur and Chiang Mai bound the regional range. Siem Reap's tourist-driven demand puts restaurant and 3-star hotel anchors near Phnom Penh levels, with beer nudged above it.
